decision.reason: [ev-d430fc53fc72] is just the one-line PR title "Reduce hop token count". It doesn't say what the hop token count belongs to (which component, API field or setting), what the old and new values are, or whether a default or a fixed value changed. It also says nothing about what happens to existing environments. None of the other items in the Features section explain it, and no linked PR body or upgrade-guide section is shown. PR #6346, or upgrade-guide text naming the field and its before/after default, is needed to write the subject, applicability and consequence.
